author: SeverinDiederichs
body:
#### PR description:

This small PR fixes a problem that occurs when running with AdePT on GPU:
In case a primary particle is returned from the GPU to the CPU because some regions cannot be offloaded, it would be re-classified, losing the existing track information.
Therefore, a track should only be classified as a primary if it was not propagated yet, which can be verified by checking the current step number.

#### PR validation:

This was verified using the latest AdePT IB which had shown some problems with this. No additional tests were added.

No backport is needed, as the AdePT integration is still in active development and will be needed only in the Phase2 setup.

@civanch @kpedro88
title: avoid re-classification if track was already transported
